inventory.outcome: Pending unattached pasted text disables Send and triggerSubmit, so no text is silently omitted.
Expanded draft shares paste handling; attachment count tells users to collapse for inspection/removal.
Compact file and pasted-text chips have inspect, readiness, removal, and bounded exact-text preview.

behavior.conversion: Plain text over 10000 UTF-16 code units becomes a local pasted-text.txt attachment for signed-in accounts after the existing attachment-slot and per-tier quota gates. Guests and blocked attachments retain a pending local chip with Back to text.
behavior.exactness: No trimming or normalization. Tabs, CRLF, Unicode, leading and trailing whitespace survive local conversion, preview pagination, and Back to text. Limits are 80000 UTF-16 code units and 200000 UTF-8 bytes; oversized input is rejected explicitly without truncation and remains on the clipboard.
behavior.recovery: Back to text restores the original selection if the draft is unchanged, otherwise appends without overwriting newer input. Undo removal restores the same local attachment without a second quota charge.
behavior.persistence: Automatic pasted-text conversion never calls attachmentAutoSave, creates a File/Blob/data URL, or uploads content. UI explicitly says reload discards local pasted text. No new persistent storage was introduced.
behavior.fileSelection: Both existing explicitly selected-file attachmentAutoSave calls remain unchanged. Existing file/auth validation and final Send payload contract remain in place.
behavior.quota: Uses actual tryUseUpload and DAILY_UPLOAD_LIMIT_BY_TIER. Local Free selection limit is two per day. Existing server validation remains authoritative at Send; this batch does not change server policy.
behavior.urls: The new local-paste path creates no object URL, so it retains none needing revocation. Existing selected-image data URL payload is retained for compatibility; chips never mount full-image thumbnails.

efficiencyEvidence.method: Node component callback/render-tree fixture running actual transpiled ChatInput plus actual pure helper and isolated real limits.ts. This is not a browser memory benchmark.
efficiencyEvidence.closedTextPreview: Zero pre elements when the attachment inspector is closed; exact attachment string remains in state.
efficiencyEvidence.openTextPreview: One selectable pre containing at most 4000 UTF-16 code units; pagination reconstructs the entire exact text without splitting surrogate pairs.
efficiencyEvidence.imageChips: Zero img elements in the chip list; one lazily loaded image only after explicit inspection.
efficiencyEvidence.byteCounting: Single UTF-16 scan matches TextEncoder byte counts, including surrogate edge cases, without allocating a second full-content byte buffer.
efficiencyEvidence.noClaim: No measured heap, CPU, decode-time or browser memory reduction is claimed. Rendering bounds and absent read/save calls are directly tested.
